subject: Airglen MAP: staged evaluation, procurement milestones, and cloud-offer billing path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@airglen.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@airglen.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Airglen initial discovery — MAP & billing questions

Hi Ethan / Sofia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns technical evaluation milestones with procurement checkpoints and the private-offer billing path. Attached is a working draft (Airglen_MAP_Draft.xlsx).

Key asks from your side to make the timeline real:
- Confirm evaluation owners (security, infra, app team) and target acceptance gates (tech & perf).
- Confirm whether Airglen will accept a private offer via AWS Marketplace (preferred) or needs Azure/GCP private offers instead.
- Any procurement constraints around PO timing or invoice routing (AP contact + billing entity).

Proposed high-level cadence (tentative):
1) Technical eval & perf run — 2 weeks (Nov 1–14)
2) Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange — parallel, 1 week
3) Legal & PO: negotiating SOW and private-offer paperwork — 1–2 weeks
4) Activation and invoice issuance (private-offer commit) — 3 business days after sign

I included a draft SOW for scope and a short SOC2 summary from our security team. Please review and let me know if the AWS private-offer route works for you; if not, we’ll pivot to GCP/Azure and update the billing steps accordingly.

Attachment: Airglen_MAP_Draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Airglen_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)

Regards,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@airglen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@airglen.com>, Airglen Procurement <procurement@airglen.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Oct 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Airglen initial discovery — MAP & billing questions

Karthik —

Thanks for the draft. A couple of clarifications from procurement and security:

- Procurement: Airglen prefers Marketplace private offers tied to our AWS Account (we manage commitments in consolidated billing). We can do GCP but that adds finance overhead and delays. PO will need to be issued to: Airglen Health, Attn: AP Team (ap@airglen.com). Our target is a Nov 30 activation.
- Security: Our InfoSec lead (Sofia) will need SOC2 artifact access and a short runbook for data handling — we need the evidence packet by Oct 30.

Can you confirm: if we proceed with AWS private offer, can Redwood accept invoice routing to our AP contact and will activation occur as soon as the private-offer commit is accepted? Also, is there any minimum time for private-offer provisioning on your side?

Ethan
Director, Platform Engineering
Airglen Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Airglen Procurement <procurement@airglen.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@airglen.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@airglen.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Airglen MAP: staged evaluation, procurement milestones, and cloud-offer billing path

Ethan / Procurement team —

Confirming responses to your questions and next steps:

1) AWS private-offer: Yes, we can run the private offer via AWS Marketplace and accept invoice routing to Airglen Health (AP contact). Activation is automated once the private-offer commitment is submitted and we receive confirmation from AWS — in practice our median turnaround is 1 business day after the commit is accepted.

2) Provisioning lead time: If you need reserved capacity or Dedicated nodes we’ll need a 5–7 business day lead to provision; for hosted/private-offer usage on shared pools activation is typically same-day to 1 business day. Please confirm expected QPS and concurrency so we can size the offer correctly.

3) SOC2 artifacts: attaching a short SOC2 evidence pack (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). For a deeper artifact exchange we can set up a secure share; Kimberly and Laura from our compliance team are CC’d to coordinate.

Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Proposed updated MAP (high level):
- Oct 24–Oct 30: Evidence exchange + initial perf tests (Airglen infra team)
- Nov 1–Nov 14: Dedicated eval & acceptance gates (perf, reliability)
- Nov 15–Nov 22: Legal & SOW finalization
- Nov 23–Nov 30: PO submission & private-offer commit 
- Dec 1: Activation target (slightly conservative to allow finance processing)

Action items for Airglen:
- Confirm final private-offer cloud (AWS confirmed above)
- Provide AP contact name/email for invoice routing (procurement@airglen.com is fine, but please provide a person)
- Send perf sizing expectations (QPS, average session lengths)

I’ll loop in our Marketplace ops and Legal once you confirm the cloud and AP contact.

Best,
Karthik

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Oct 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Airglen MAP — pricing levers & billing flow (internal)

Team —

Quick internal note before we finalize the MAP with Airglen:

- Proposed commitment: $120k ARR (12-month) via AWS private-offer. Consider 10% promotional credit for first 3 months to accelerate acceptance — needs approval from Sales Ops.
- Billing route: AWS will invoice Airglen; Redwood will receive the private-offer confirmation. Finance requires the following fields on the PO: legal entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), remit-to, and AWS private-offer ID. We should include a line in the SOW clarifying invoice timing and contact for billing disputes.
- Provisioning: If Airglen requests Dedicated, we need to add a provisioning buffer of 7 business days and note that Dedicated increases the minimum commitment.

Laura / Jonas — can you review the SOW section on billing wording and confirm the credit authorization process? I want to be ready to move quickly once procurement confirms AP contact.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Compliance & Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@airglen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Airglen Procurement <procurement@airglen.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Nov 2028 16:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Airglen MAP: staged evaluation, procurement milestones, and cloud-offer billing path

Karthik / Kimberly —

All good here. Procurement confirmed AP contact below:
- Name: Jenna Ortiz
- Email: jenna.ortiz@airglen.com

Airglen confirms AWS private-offer route and is comfortable with the proposed cadence. A couple final notes:
- We will prioritize SOC2 artifacts by Oct 30 (done).
- Performance sizing: targeting ~120 QPS peak, ~30 concurrent sessions for initial eval (we'll hand off logs to Redwood infra next week).
- Procurement will issue PO for the $120k commitment pending SOW language clarifying invoice routing to Airglen Health / Jenna Ortiz.

Please proceed to draft the final MAP and updated SOW; procurement expects a DocuSign link for signature once legal is complete.

Sofia
Head of InfoSec (acting)
Airglen Health
